breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting boundary conditions (Dirichlet and periodic). It resolved the conflict by only specifying the Dirichlet condition ('Apply homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions: u = 0 on all four edges of the domain'), completely omitting the incorrect periodic condition, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
